facts.question: How many Olympic gold medals has India won in field hockey?
facts.statement: India have won 8 Olympic gold medals in field hockey.
facts.explanation: India's eight hockey golds are the most by any nation.

facts.question: How many players per team are on the field in field hockey?
facts.statement: Field hockey is played with 11 players per team on the field.
facts.explanation: Each side fields ten outfield players and a goalkeeper.

facts.question: In which year did India win its most recent Olympic hockey gold?
facts.statement: India won its most recent Olympic hockey gold in 1980.
facts.explanation: India took gold at the Moscow Games in 1980.

facts.question: How many minutes long is a modern international field hockey match?
facts.statement: A modern international field hockey match lasts 60 minutes, split into four quarters.
facts.explanation: The FIH moved from two 35-minute halves to four 15-minute quarters in 2014.

facts.question: How many successive Olympic Games did India win hockey gold from 1928?
facts.statement: India won hockey gold at 6 successive Olympic Games from 1928 onwards.
facts.explanation: India's run covered Amsterdam, Los Angeles, Berlin, London, Helsinki and Melbourne.

facts.question: How many Hockey World Cup titles has Pakistan won?
facts.statement: Pakistan have won 4 Hockey World Cup titles.
facts.explanation: Pakistan won in 1971, 1978, 1982 and 1994 - more than any other nation.

facts.question: In which year was the first men's Hockey World Cup held?
facts.statement: The first men's Hockey World Cup was held in 1971.
facts.explanation: Pakistan beat Spain in the inaugural final in Barcelona.

facts.question: Which medal did India win in men's hockey at the Tokyo 2020 Olympics?
facts.statement: India won the bronze medal in men's hockey at the Tokyo 2020 Olympics.
facts.explanation: The 5-4 win over Germany ended a 41-year wait for an Olympic hockey medal.
